slides.texte_overlay:
How to rebuild your life
from zero

01 Clean your room

Start with the space you wake up in.
Order outside, order inside.

02 Write down where you are

Money, health, friends, work.
Honest numbers, no judgment.

03 Pick one physical habit

Ten push-ups a day is enough.
Then eleven.

04 Call one person who believed
in you

Tell them you're starting again.

05 Learn a little every day

New knowledge, new ideas,
new version of you.
